title: AAAR-1.0: Assessing AI's Potential to Assist Research

model.params_source: assumed (paper gives no decoding parameters for o3-mini; Appendix B.2: closed-source models run three times and the median reported)

task.subset_rule: all: 1,049 EQINFER instances x 4 candidate equations (1,049 positive + 3,147 negative)
task.approximation: the prediction prompt is a figure (image) in the paper and must be transcribed; the paper reports the median of three runs, here a single run with item bootstrap

fields.input: context_before + context_after (LaTeX source around the equation slot)
fields.options: options_list (4 LaTeX equations, labels (A)-(D); one positive, three negative)
fields.label: answer (letter of the positive equation); each option becomes one binary item

prompt.user_template: NOT AVAILABLE IN THE TEXT EXTRACTION: the EQINFER prediction prompt is Figure 11 (an image). Transcribe it from the PDF and insert it here with placeholders {context_before}, {context_after}, {options}.

placeholders.context_before: items.context_before (truncated to the context length used for Table 1)

prompt.source_location: Appendix E, Figure 11 (EQINFER data-collection and model-prediction prompts)
prompt.verbatim: none: Figure 11 is an image in the extracted text; nothing could be copied

output.parse: to be fixed after transcription: expected either a per-equation binary judgment or a selected letter (A-D) per instance (Sec. 5.1 describes one-by-one and whole-list prompting)
output.postprocess: strip; per-equation predictions derived from the chosen letter(s)

metric.name: micro_f1
metric.definition: F1 (%) over the 4,196 candidate equations with the positive (correct) equation as the positive class (Sec. 4: F1 is the EQINFER criterion)
metric.original_location: Table 1, row o3-mini, column F1 (Prec. 34.34, Rec. 79.59)

open_points: The EQINFER model-prediction prompt is Figure 11 of the PDF (an image); the extraction holds only the caption, so the template must be transcribed from the PDF before a hook can render it.
Fix the protocol behind Table 1 for o3-mini: one-by-one classification of each equation or whole-list selection (Sec. 5.1 discusses both), and the input-context length (Appendix B / Table 12).
Decide whether to mirror the paper's three-run median (3,147 calls) or the single run assumed here.
notes: Cost estimate assumes one whole-list call per instance with long LaTeX contexts (~10k tokens). o3-mini has a single snapshot; the version list in Appendix B.2 predates it. || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook: prompt not in the text extraction.
